summary: Iteration 10 frontend-only regression. Verified the offline-only auth removal changes on 390x844 viewport. Confirmed login.tsx and register.tsx are deleted (both /login and /register return Expo Router 'Unmatched Route' 404). Splash → tap → /(tabs)/dashboard directly with 'Good morning, Dr. Veterinarian' greeting. Settings has no Edit Profile pencil, no Logout button, has 'Reset Local Data' button, and the profile card shows 'Veterinarian' + 'Doctor • Offline Mode'. End-to-end New Evaluation flow works without any sign-in (Dog & Owner → Cytology → cell counts (10/20/20/30/20 = 100) → Calculate → Result page shows 'Mid Proestrus' 78%). AuthContext contains no backend URL calls (only AsyncStorage + optional Sheets webhook) so the built-APK failure mode ('Invalid URL: /api/auth/google') is no longer possible. ONE FUNCTIONAL BUG found: tapping Reset Local Data in a live session leaves user=null (dashboard renders blank) until the app is fully relaunched/reloaded — AuthContext's anonymous-user bootstrap only runs in the mount useEffect and is not re-triggered after logout().

ui_bugs.issue: After tapping 'Reset Local Data', logout() clears storage and setUser(null), then splash routes to /(tabs)/dashboard. Because AuthContext's anonymous-user bootstrap useEffect only runs on mount, no fresh anonymous user is recreated in the same JS session, so the dashboard header + stats render blank (only the bottom tab bar is visible). Only a full app reload/kill-and-relaunch heals it (verified: after page.reload(), localStorage.current_user is repopulated with a new UUID and dashboard renders correctly).

react_native_issues.issue: Console shows web-preview warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing.' Cosmetic on web preview only; will use native driver on the actual APK. No action needed.

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — a Pressable/View somewhere is passing pointerEvents as a prop. Not blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:64 (or a wrapping RN component).

Console error: 'Invalid DOM property `transform-origin`. Did you mean `transformOrigin`?' — a StyleSheet somewhere sets 'transform-origin' instead of 'transformOrigin'. Cosmetic; safe to ignore for APK but should be renamed.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/auth/AuthContext.tsx, make logout() recreate a fresh anonymous UserProfile (same logic as the mount-time bootstrap) instead of only calling setUser(null). This makes 'Reset Local Data' work in a single JS session so the dashboard doesn't render blank until the app is relaunched.
OPTIONAL: In /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/dashboard.tsx, if user is null show a small loader/placeholder or auto-redirect back to '/' so the header doesn't flash blank.
OPTIONAL: Grep the codebase for `transform-origin` and rename to `transformOrigin`, and find the deprecated `pointerEvents` prop and move it into style (both are console-warning cleanups).
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.useEffect on lines 45-76 parses `stored` twice (once inside try/catch, once again in the `cur` recomputation). Minor duplication; can be simplified to a single parse + null-guard.

logout() (lines 132-135) does not recreate the anonymous user. Given the app is now advertised as 'offline, no sign-in ever', logout should immediately provision a new anonymous UserProfile instead of leaving user=null (which the rest of the app assumes will never happen after boot).

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (7/8 scenarios pass; Reset Local Data has a session-persistence gap)

seed_data_creation: Created transient evaluations via /api/dogs + /api/evaluations with dog names TEST_Bella and TEST_Bella2 while validating the end-to-end flow; no cleanup required for the offline-app assertions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: login.tsx and register.tsx are confirmed deleted at the filesystem level. /login and /register on the preview URL return 'Unmatched Route'. All splash/dashboard/settings/new-evaluation UI works at 390x844. The only remaining functional gap is the Reset Local Data → same-session dashboard blank state, caused by AuthContext.logout() not re-provisioning an anonymous user. After main agent fixes logout(), retest by (1) opening app, (2) going to Settings, (3) tapping Reset Local Data, (4) tapping splash, (5) verifying dashboard shows 'Good morning, Dr. Veterinarian' immediately without a page reload.
rca_of_issue: Root cause: /app/frontend/src/auth/AuthContext.tsx only creates an anonymous UserProfile inside the mount-time useEffect (line 45). logout() (line 132) merely removes the storage key and sets user state to null. Because React does not remount AuthProvider on route change, the guarantee 'a local anonymous user always exists' is broken between the moment Reset Local Data is tapped and the moment the app is fully restarted. Reproduction: launch app → splash → tap → dashboard renders OK → Settings → Reset Local Data → splash appears → tap splash → dashboard renders blank (only tab bar). Mitigation: In logout(), instead of setUser(null), synchronously build a new anonymous UserProfile (same shape as the bootstrap) and persist+setUser it. Then the user state stays non-null across the splash → dashboard transition.
